Lesson overview

⁧مَرَّ⁩ "pass' means: ⁧رَدَّ⁩ • reply • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • ⁧ظَنَّ⁩ They have the same second and third radicals: sometimes they write with shadda ( ⁧رَدَّ⁩ ), sometimes separate ( ⁧رَدَدْتُ⁩ ). ⁧أَخَذَ⁩ , ⁧سَأَلَ⁩ , ⁧قَرَأَ⁩ they have a hamza in the root, and the hamza changes its seat ( ⁧أ⁩ , ⁧ؤ⁩ , ⁧ئ⁩ , ⁧ء⁩ ) according to the neighboring vowels: ⁧سَأَلَ⁩ , ⁧سُؤَال⁩ , ⁧سُئِلَ⁩ . In this unit you learn when doubling melts, the short forms of some verbs with hamza ( ⁧خُذْ⁩ , ⁧كُلْ⁩ ) and above all the rule to write the hamza, which you need to write under dictation and to search for words in the dictionary. A week.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-16), voice synthesizer script (dedicated), tutor session
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. Conjugate doubled verbs ( ⁧رَدَّ⁩ , ⁧مَرَّ⁩ , ⁧ظَنَّ⁩ ) and recognize when the double splits ( ⁧رَدَدْتُ⁩ );
2. combine verbs with hamza ( ⁧أَخَذَ⁩ , ⁧أَكَلَ⁩ , ⁧سَأَلَ⁩ , ⁧قَرَأَ⁩ , ⁧بَدَأَ⁩ ), including forms ⁧آخُذُ⁩ and ⁧خُذْ⁩ , ⁧كُلْ⁩ ;
3. to write the hamza at the beginning, in the middle and end of the word with the strongest vowel rule;
4. recognise ⁧تَمَّ⁩ + maṣdar in the news;
5. write under dictation words with hamza and doubles.

2. Verbs doubled
1. The rule. The two equal letters are together (with the shadda) when a vowel comes later: ⁧رَدَّ⁩ , ⁧رَدَّتْ⁩ ,
⁧رَدُّوا⁩ , ⁧يَرُدُّ⁩ . They separate when a consonant comes later: ⁧رَدَدْتُ⁩ , ⁧رَدَدْنَا⁩ , ⁧رَدَدْنَ⁩ .
2. The juxtaposition has two forms: ⁧لَمْ يَرُدَّ⁩ (the most used) and ⁧لَمْ يَرْدُدْ⁩ (formal, in written texts). The same for the imperative:

2. Short Imperatives: ⁧خُذْ⁩ , ⁧كُلْ⁩ , ⁧مُرْ⁩ I forgive the hamza; other verbs with initial hamza have regular imperative

Hamza second radical: ⁧سَأَلَ⁩
⁧سَأَلَ⁩ , ⁧يَسْأَلُ⁩ , ⁧سَأَلْتُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَسْأَلْ⁩ , ⁧اِسْأَلْ⁩ (also ⁧سَلْ⁩ , formal). Participle ⁧سَائِل⁩ and the maṣdar ⁧سُؤَال⁩ show how the hamza changes seat: it is always the same radical.

4. How to write the hamza
At the beginning of the word

The initial hamza is always on an alif: above with a and u ( ⁧أَخَذَ⁩ , ⁧أُخْت⁩ ), below with ( ⁧إِسْلَام⁩ , ⁧إِلَى⁩ ). When the alif is a union alif (hamzat) al-waṣl, L0), the hamza is not written: ⁧اِسْم⁩ , ⁧اِبْن⁩ , ⁧اِسْتَقْبَلَ⁩ .
In the middle of the word: the strongest vowel
Look at the hamza vowel and the vowel first. The most powerful wins: i > u > a > sukūn.
a (fatḥa) ⁧أ⁩ (alif) ⁧يَسْأَلُ⁩ · ⁧رَأْس⁩ · ⁧سَأَلَ⁩
Two special cases:

1. After a ā long, if the hamza has a: on line ( ⁧ء⁩ ): ⁧تَسَاءَلَ⁩ The Commission therefore considers that the measures provided for in this Regulation are in accordance with the opinion of the Standing Committee on Plants, Animals, Food and Feed, as appropriate, should be implemented. ⁧قِرَاءَة⁩ . If you have an i or u, follow the
rule: ⁧قَائِل⁩ , ⁧تَفَاؤُل⁩ • Optimism.
2. After ī or ay: on the tooth ( ⁧ئ⁩ ): ⁧بِيئَة⁩ • environment • • ⁧هَيْئَة⁩ "Ente" is the entity.
At the end of the word

With the endings, the final hamza can change seat: ⁧شَيْء⁩ → ⁧شَيْئًا⁩ (in front of the alif of the tanwīn, after ⁧ي⁩ the hamza goes on the tooth), ⁧جُزْء⁩ → ⁧جُزْءًا⁩ , ⁧سَمَاء⁩ → ⁧سَمَاءً⁩ (after ā no addition of the alif of tanwīn). These cases are learned word by word: for now know how to recognize them.
Practical summary
1. Start word → always alif ( ⁧أ⁩ , ⁧إ⁩ ).
2. In the middle → wins the strongest vowel (i: ⁧ئ⁩ , u: ⁧ؤ⁩ , a: ⁧أ⁩ ).
3. In the end after short vowel → seat of the vowel; after long vowel or sukūn → ⁧ء⁩ .
4. In the dictionary the hamza is a consonant like the others: ⁧سُؤَال⁩ and ⁧سَائِل⁩ search below ⁧س أ ل⁩ .
5. ⁧تَمَّ⁩ in the news and others doubled useful

⁧تَمَّ⁩ + maṣdar It's been done... It's a very frequent way in the news to avoid passive: ⁧تَمَّ افْتِتَاحُ المَكْتَبَةِ⁩ The library has been inaugurated. ⁧تَمَّ القَبْضُ عَلَى السَّارِقِ⁩ The thief has been arrested. ⁧سَيَتِمُّ تَغْيِيرُ المَوْعِدِ⁩ The time will be changed. The grammatical subject is the maṣdar; the verb ⁧تَمَّ⁩ usually stays with the male. 6. Pronunciation

Double. straight / straight: in the first the d is double and long; In the second there are two d separated by one vowel. Listen carefully to the forms of ... ẓanantu, marartu. The hamza in the middle. saʾala, suʾāl, masʾūl, yaqraʾūn: The hamza is a slight glottis stroke, not an extension of the vowel. Don't say ""suāl• • • • • • • • • • • • • •masūl». āʾ Final. samāʾ, ǧuzʾ, šayʾ, ḍawʾ: at the end of the word the hamza is heard, even if short.
